= mailto-query(1)
:manmanual: Mailto tests
:mansource: acdc

== Name
mailto-query - email subjects and bodies

== Synopsis
Email links.

== Description

mailto:subject@example.org[Subject,Test subject]

mailto:both@example.org[Both,Test subject,Message body]

mailto:fallback@example.org[,Test subject,Message body]

mailto:body@example.org[Body,"",Message body]

mailto:empty@example.org[Empty,"",""]

mailto:quoted@example.org[Quoted,"Hello, world","Say \"hello\", please"]

mailto:unicode@example.org[Unicode,"Café & tea? + 50% #1 ~","x=y / café"]

mailto:named@example.org[Named,role=green,Test subject,Message body]

mailto:named-only@example.org[Named only,subject=Ignored,body=Ignored]

mailto:query@example.org?cc=copy@example.org&subject=Existing[Query,New subject,New body]

mailto:escape@example.org[Escape,Subject\],Body\]]

mailto:control@example.org[Control]

mailto:trailing@example.org[Trailing,]

mailto:unquoted@example.org[Unquoted,,Body]

mailto:numeric@example.org[Numeric,2=Ignored,3=Ignored]

mailto:attributes@example.org[Styled,Subject,Body,role=green,id=mail]

mailto:single@example.org[Single,'It\'s fine','Say "hello"']

mailto:passarg@example.org[Pass argument,+one,two+,{plus}]

mailto:empty-target@example.org[]

mailto:plain@example.org[Plain text,"*Bold* <tag> (C)","a -> b"]

\mailto:literal@example.org[Literal,Subject,Body]
